## Summary

Describe the purpose and user-visible effect of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Gradle build or tests were run.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or setup changes.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a recording.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and commits contain no API keys, tokens, personal data, local paths, runtime databases, APKs, or generated artifacts.
